claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Ouabain at 2.5 uM inhibits the Na+/K+-ATPase (ATP1A1), causing loss of ionic gradients and calcium overload that kills cells; this is a cardiac glycoside class effect rather than a kinase-mediated mechanism.
